profile_name: Packaged Commodities Legal Metrology Screening Profile (Rules 2011)
note: Decision-support first-level screening profile implementing Rules 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 13 of The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011.

product_identity.source_rule: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 6(1)(b)
product_identity.requirement: The common or generic names of the commodity contained in the package and in case of packages with more than one product, the name and number or quantity of each product.
product_identity.applicability: All packaged commodities intended for retail sale
product_identity.validation: Must identify generic/common name or prominent commodity title
product_identity.notes: Generic section headers (e.g. nutrition, ingredients, care) must not be substituted for commodity identity.
product_identity.legal_name: Common or Generic Name of Commodity

manufacturer_packer.source_rule: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 6(1)(a) & Rule 10
manufacturer_packer.requirement: The name and complete address of the manufacturer, or where manufacturer is not the packer, the name and complete address of the manufacturer and packer, or in case of imported packages, the name and complete address of the importer.
manufacturer_packer.validation: Must indicate name and address with identifiable role (manufacturer, packer, marketer, importer)
manufacturer_packer.notes: Postal PIN codes provide strong supporting evidence of address completeness.
manufacturer_packer.legal_name: Name and Complete Address of Manufacturer / Packer / Marketer

net_quantity.source_rule: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 6(1)(c) & Rule 13
net_quantity.requirement: The net quantity, in terms of the standard unit of weight or measure, of the commodity contained in the package.
net_quantity.applicability: All packaged commodities with quantifiable contents
net_quantity.validation: Standard SI metric units (g, kg, ml, l, mg, pcs, units, n, u) with explicit context
net_quantity.notes: Must not mistake nutrition table quantities or date years for net quantity declaration.
net_quantity.legal_name: Net Quantity in Standard Metric Units

manufacture_date.source_rule: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 6(1)(d)
manufacture_date.requirement: The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or pre-packed or imported.
manufacture_date.applicability: All packages except commodities exempted under Rule 26
manufacture_date.validation: Month and year of manufacture or packaging (excluding expiry date alone)
manufacture_date.notes: Best Before or Use By dates alone do NOT satisfy the mandatory pre-packing/manufacturing date requirement.
manufacture_date.legal_name: Month and Year of Manufacture / Pre-packing

mrp.source_rule: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 6(1)(e) & Rule 3(m)
mrp.requirement: The retail sale price of the package in terms of Maximum Retail Price (MRP) inclusive of all taxes.
mrp.applicability: All packaged commodities intended for retail sale
mrp.validation: Currency designation with numeric amount and 'inclusive of all taxes' declaration
mrp.notes: Arbitrary numbers without retail price context or currency formatting must be rejected.
mrp.legal_name: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) inclusive of all taxes

consumer_contact.source_rule: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 6(2)
consumer_contact.requirement: Every package shall bear the name, address, telephone number, and e-mail address of the person who can be contacted by the consumer in case of a complaint.
consumer_contact.validation: Toll-free helpline (1800), verified phone number, or complaint email address with consumer care context
consumer_contact.notes: Barcode numbers and license numbers must not be treated as consumer grievance contacts.
